{{- /* The page's table of contents (toc.html, toc-mobile.html): Hugo's, from the content headings, plus an API symbol's member groups (api-member-groups.html), whose sections the template renders after the content, where .TableOfContents does not see them. Each group lists its members by their own name (api-member-name.html), not `Owner.name`: the owner is the page itself, and repeated it truncated every entry in the narrow column. Expects: the page. Returns the HTML string, "" when there is nothing to list. */ -}} {{- $toc := string .TableOfContents -}} {{- if eq (trim ($toc | plainify) " \n") "" }}{{ $toc = "" }}{{ end -}} {{- with partial "api-member-groups.html" . -}} {{- $items := "" -}} {{- range . -}} {{- $members := "" -}} {{- range .members -}} {{- $members = printf "%s
  • %s
    • \n" $members (anchorize .Title) ((partial "api-member-name.html" .).name | htmlEscape) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $items = printf "%s
  • %s\n
      \n%s
    \n
    • \n" $items .id .title $members -}} {{- end -}} {{- if $toc -}} {{- $toc = replaceRE `(?s)\s*\s*$` (printf "%s\n" $items) $toc -}} {{- else -}} {{- $toc = printf "
    \n
      \n%s
    \n
    " $items -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $toc -}}
